title: GOD'S WONDER - THE CAPSTONE MINISTRY

blocks.text: “This is a day of God’s wonders, we are approaching a new move from God. It is gradually picking up uniting momentum among His people everywhere! God times His revivals and no one starts or stops Him!” Isa. 40:13, “Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being His counselor hath taught Him?” Isa. 46:10 reveals, “He declares the end from the be- ginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My council shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure!” Isa. 41:10, “Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee!” The Scriptures say, “They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run and not be weary.” Isa. 40:31 – Isa. 32:15, “Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field!”

We have seen this Scripture fulfilled in the Capstone Ministry. – Zech. 10:1, “Ask ye of the Lord rain in the time of the latter rain; so the Lord shall make bright clouds, and give them showers of rain, to every one grass in the field.” We have seen this by photographs His beautiful clouds in color and the brightness of His spirit as rain upon the ground! We know His final move is near! Joel 2:21-28 reveals a mighty outpouring to His children and then later to Israel. Verse 21, notice it says, “Fear not,” then it says, “be glad and rejoice for the Lord will do great things!” Verses 24 and 25, “And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil!” These are all symbolic of the diverse operation of His spirit and Word! – “And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten!” – “New restoration is definitely coming!” Verse 25, “means to bring back to the original state! All gifts, fruits and power will be restored in unity of His spirit! Sound-sound!” “Notice it says the Lord will do great things!” “New things are coming, a mighty awakening to prepare His people for translation!” “Thus saith the Lord!” – “There is a cloudburst of His presence appearing, the bride will make herself ready by the anointing, gifts and Word, covering her in His glowing truths!” The Lord has the Capstone Ministry in all His chambers of power! “His pillar of fire will guide us and His cloud is over it! His star has been seen here numerous times!” Christ’s star was seen at His first coming, Matt. 2:2, in the East; it is setting in the West with the Gentile bride and with the Capstone head!” “It shall be seen again, Rev. 22:16, the bright and morning star! The super celestial light, the immortal God standing overshadowing His true people!”

“We have had a former rain revival, but there is to be a real latter rain spiritual refreshing in our day – now appearing!” Isa.28:10-12, To whom he said, “This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear!” “But God’s people will hear and now they will receive the rest and the refreshing move! They will mount up like eagles in the wind of the spirit!” Verse 16, “They will be supported by the precious corner stone, a sure foundation.” – “We remember a great outpouring come when Elijah went to the upper Chamber – miracles occurred.” When the 120 were in the upper Chamber the wind of the Holy Spirit covered them in great power – revival!” “And a great stirring will occur again in miracles and a mighty restoration full of God’s power!” Isa. 43:18-19, “Remember ye not the former things, behold I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? – I will even make a way in the wilderness and rivers in the desert!” – “For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thy offspring!” (Isa. 44:3)

“A repeat of the “book of Acts” is returning to cleanse His church and endue them with power and to keep His chosen away from the temptation coming in the world system (a snare)! Many will lose out because they turn to the World System for help, pleasure, finances and in food, etc., instead of uniting with Jesus in restoration rain!” “He will meet His people’s needs during the shortages and economic crisis, no doubt there will be temptation for many to give in to the anti-Christ system! This will occur just before the Bride leaves!” – Isa. 26:20, “Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy door about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpassed!”
God bless, love and protect you,
